title: GPT-SoVITS — Local 1-Minute Voice Cloning (Open Source)
description:
Clone realistic voices on your machine instead of uploading audio to a paid cloud. GPT-SoVITS trains a local TTS model from a tiny sample and runs from a simple WebUI.
